name: s81hc_ccfh2_ref

job.purpose: FV pin capture isolates the die port from distributed POST replicas; FD retains its existing direct pin-capture flop. Pad FV depth4/FD5 transfers only the required control stage, preserving all output epochs with about14196sinks. Balanced clock spine repairs the measured171psspread. Final actual hop audit is required.

why_floorplan: v3 (ccf v2 89a4bcc13 NEEDS_HUMAN PPL-0111: N face carries 3697 pins (fd_i 1128 + n_y 2560 + fv_i 7 + n_yacc + yfl) but 302.4 um gives 3135 slots): pin-bound outline 410.4 um (~4.25k N slots, 87%), single macro column centred at x 118.8 (W/E channels ~119/~118 um for rd_out/wd_in and wd_in/w_mask edges), y data N->S over the column on M5. Util below 45% is pin-bound (vertical n_y/ch_fd chain must stay on N/S for tile abutment). v2: single macro column replacing the ee56cc32d 2x3 grid (GRT 10k markers in one 20 um channel).; v3 five independent512-bit FIFO controllers colocate state/macro; kept128-bit popcopies and512-bit inputrelay break shared3599-load select and long N->macro stages; same outline/clock<15k expected. v4: see structural_change; N 8.5 / S 7.0 bits/um/layer over the two channels (limit 12).
